title: GE4u Daily Practice: Dental English
objective: Review three core terms and practise one knowledge check in Dental English.

vocabulary.definition: Pain in or around a tooth.
vocabulary.example: The patient reported a severe toothache at night.

vocabulary.definition: An assessment of the oral cavity, teeth, gingiva and related structures.
vocabulary.example: An oral examination is part of the initial dental assessment.

vocabulary.definition: An image produced using X-rays for diagnostic assessment.
vocabulary.example: The dentist reviewed the dental radiograph.

quiz.question: Which term means inflammation of the gingiva?
quiz.explanation: Gingivitis is inflammation of the gingiva.
